content: While taking this medication, and for at least three days after completing it, you should avoid consuming alcoholic beverages. This medication, cefotetan, may reduce the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines, such as the typhoid vaccine. Additionally, cefotetan can pass into breast milk, so consult your healthcare provider if you are breastfeeding. Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. It is important to maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this information with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as urine glucose tests or serum and urine creatinine tests, potentially leading to inaccurate results. In the event of an overdose, if the individual experiences severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition and should not be used for other purposes unless directed by your healthcare provider. While using this medication, your doctor may order laboratory or medical tests, such as a complete blood count or kidney function tests, to monitor your progress and check for side effects. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Different brands or packaging of this medication may have specific storage requirements. Refer to the product packaging for instructions on how to store your specific brand, or consult your pharmacist. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
